body:
Tier: T3
Why: This is the client half of the C05 item 7 workout-reminder slice, a T3 cross-repo feature. It changes a preference the backend jobs read: the opt-out toggle, plus the device timezone that decides when a reminder is sent. It is graded with the backend PR rather than averaged down.
T4 trigger scan: none. No auth, payment, entitlement or data-sharing change. The only network call is the existing PATCH `/notifications/preferences` with fields the user already owns.
T3 trigger scan: cross-repo contract. It adds the new backend preference fields `workout_reminder_push` and `workout_reminder_inapp`, and timezone sync from the device to the server that the backend scheduler depends on.
Bounded T1: NO. The UI part is small, but the contract and timing semantics are owned by the T3 backend slice (backend PR #609).
Builder/owner: Claude Opus 5.5 (engagement builder; fix round by lane B-JOURNEY, agent 111). Parent owner: operator agent 111.
Acceptance evidence:
- `NotificationPreferencesScreen.workoutReminders.test.tsx`:
  - toggle is on by default;
  - toggle shows the server value;
  - turning it off PATCHes `{ workout_reminder_push: false, workout_reminder_inapp: false }`.
- `timezoneSync.test.ts`:
  - device zone is sent once per account and again only when it changes;
  - a second account on the same device syncs its own row;
  - a malformed or missing session token never reads a cached stamp;
  - a failed sync is not cached and is retried.
- Toggle failure paths: the server value beats a stale local copy; an offline open keeps the local value; a failed save rolls the switch back and alerts.
- Local results:
  - at `90e78ab`: these two suites (13 tests), `notificationCenter.test.tsx` (15), `quietLuxuryDoctrine.test.ts` and `declaredDependencies.test.ts` (42) pass;
  - `tsc --noEmit` is clean;
  - eslint on touched files is clean.
- CI is authoritative.
Promotion triggers: re-grade if the toggle starts writing any field beyond the two reminder flags, or if timezone sync starts sending anything beyond the IANA zone.

## What
- **Settings > Notifications**: new "Workout reminders" switch. Description: "A short note from Roman at your preferred training time on session days." It is on by default and maps to the backend `workout_reminder_push` and `workout_reminder_inapp`. On mount, the screen reads the server value through `GET /notifications/preferences`, so the switch never shows a stale state. It uses the existing optimistic update and rollback path.
- **`src/services/timezoneSync.ts`**: sends the device IANA zone from `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone` via the existing PATCH `/notifications/preferences { timezone }`. It sends once per change and per signed-in account (cache stamp `<session sub>|<zone>` in AsyncStorage; without a readable account it always sends and caches nothing), is best-effort, and is called from `App.tsx` after sign-in, independent of push permission. It does not prompt.
- `src/screens/settings/README.md` is updated.
- Visual changes: one more row in the existing card, with the existing styles and Ionicons `barbell-outline`. No new styles, colours or motion. Copy has no exclamation marks and no emojis.

## Backend dependency
Backend PR #609 adds the preference fields. Against an older backend, the PATCH for the new fields may be rejected or ignored by the whitelist, and on a rejection the toggle rolls back with the existing "Could not save preference" alert. The timezone field already exists on the backend. Merge after #609. #609 itself is stacked on backend #607, so the order is backend #607, then backend #609, then this PR.

API alignment with #609 at `40616dcf` (checked line by line): `GET /notifications/preferences` returns `workout_reminder_push` and `workout_reminder_inapp`, also in the defaults it returns before a row exists (both `true`). `PATCH /notifications/preferences` accepts both as optional booleans and `timezone` as an optional string of at most 64 characters. The reminder job resolves an invalid IANA zone to its default zone instead of failing. The kill switch `WORKOUT_REMINDERS_ENABLED` is server-side only, and the toggle does not depend on it.

## Fix round (B-JOURNEY, agent 111)

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INT-1: DIRTY against main | Merged main `e3986e89` (merge commit, no rebase). The only conflict was `src/screens/settings/README.md`, where main had rewritten the file; resolution keeps main's text and appends this PR's section unchanged | `608470e` | full CI at the head |
| TZ-1: the cache was device-wide, so a second account on the same device never synced its timezone and got reminders at the backend default zone | Cache stamp scoped to the session `sub`; no account means always send and no cache | `90e78ab` | `timezoneSync.test.ts` (second account, malformed token, retry) |
| TEST-1: no proof of the failure paths of the toggle | Stale local copy vs server value, offline open, failed save rollback with alert | `90e78ab` | `NotificationPreferencesScreen.workoutReminders.test.tsx` |
title: C05 item 7: Workout reminders toggle in Settings > Notifications + device timezone sync
